snippet.title: Duke Grabowski: Mighty Swashbuckler | Trailer [GOG]
snippet.description:
GOG Preservation Program! 
https://www.youtube.com/@gogclassicsvault
Follow us on:
Web: 👉  https://bit.ly/3rpVmMh
Twitch: 👉  https://bit.ly/3vVI6CJ
Twitter: 👉  https://bit.ly/3fdOUFK
Facebook: 👉  https://bit.ly/2NWKVCw

Set sail on this comedic pirate journey inspired by classic swashbuckling tales! A hilarious point-and-click pirate adventure starring a lovable brute on a quest to prove he’s worthy of becoming captain.

Play as Duke, a pirate who’s had success in pillaging, ransacking, and other forms of piratey goodness, but doesn’t know a thing about women! Solve puzzles, explore vibrant Caribbean islands, and interact with eccentric characters - from zombie sailors to wrestling gorillas.
